sources: recreation.gov public search API, per-site catalog for facility 234009

values.note: $17 a standard site, $30 one of the few 30/50-amp electric sites (2026 peak season); $5 per extra vehicle (first 2 free); double occupancy charged for a second camping unit. Day use $5 a vehicle or a $50 boat-launch season pass.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234009/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-21 to 2026-09-13: standard nonelectric $17, electric $30; walk-in season 2026-09-14 to 10-01 $17) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/philipsburg-bay-campground ('Single Site: $17 per night, Additional Vehicle: $5 per night', '$5.00 day-use fee per vehicle with an option for a $50.00 season pass for the boat launch'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov public search API for facility 234009 (4 STANDARD ELECTRIC sites, 3 listing 30/50 amps, water 'No'; 30 STANDARD NONELECTRIC) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234009/rates (electric $30), read 2026-10-22

values.note: recreation.gov: 65 sites, 34 reservable and 31 first-come; the Forest Service page says 68 sites. Maximum recommended trailer length 32 ft.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234009 ('The campground has 65 sites in total, 34 sites are reservable and 31 sites are available as first-come, first-served') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/philipsburg-bay-campground ('The facility has 68 sites', 'The maximum recommended trailer length for the area is 32 feet'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: No dump station; the closest is in Anaconda.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/philipsburg-bay-campground ('Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available at this site') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234009 (notice: 'No dump station on site; closest facility is in Anaconda'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'Open annually from mid-May through late September, weather dependent.' recreation.gov's 2026 walk-in rate season runs to October 1.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/philipsburg-bay-campground (Seasons of Use: 'Open annually from mid-May through late September, weather dependent.'; page last updated September 1, 2026), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 34 sites reservable (Loop C and half of Loop B, in the summer season), 31 first-come (Loop A and the other half of B); self-pay station, cash or check. Booking closes 4 days before arrival. recreation.gov's 3-night holiday-weekend minimum is marked 'soft', so it may be relaxed for a same-day booking. 16-day stay limit (32 nights a year).

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234009 (description: 'Loop A and half of loop B are first-come, first-served. Loop C and half of Loop B can be reserved in advance during the summer season'; rules: reservationCutOff 4 day(s) prior to arrival, minHolidayWeekendStay 3 soft, maxConsecutiveStay 16, maxStay 32 nights each year; notice 'Camping stay limit is 16 days') + Forest Service page ('16 day stay limit'), read 2026-10-22

note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF campground (Pintler RD) on Georgetown Lake, about 11 mi south of Philipsburg, overlooking the Anaconda-Pintler Wilderness. Paved roads and a boat ramp. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page + recreation.gov (Forest Service, Pintler RD; mixed reservable/FCFS): confirmed $17-$30, 50-amp electric on 4 sites, 65 sites, 32-ft max, vault toilets, drinking water, recreation.gov booking with some FCFS; added no dump station, 4-day cutoff, 3-night soft holiday minimum, 16-night limit; season close 09-13 (a rate-season edge) cleared, the FS states only 'mid-May through late September'. FS page says 68 sites against rec.gov's 65 (noted). Alerts: only the standing food-storage and pallet orders. Note trimmed of restated values.
